basicSetup.title: Setup and Core Loop
basicSetup.description: Start directly from the real pre-haunt board and learn the first true decision entry point.

steps.setupRuntime: This chapter drops you straight into the real pre-haunt state for the first scenario instead of teaching character select as a standalone lesson.
steps.objectiveAndTurn: Before the haunt, your job is to keep exploring the house. On your turn, the five core actions are move, explore, trade, use, and end turn.
steps.traitsAndSpeed: Speed is the first trait to read here. It tells you the movement range your explorer can work with before spending any steps.
steps.movesRemaining: The MOVE medallion in the upper-right shows how many steps you still have right now this turn. That current remainder is not always the same as your full speed value.
steps.roomBoard: The central room board is the main play area. First read where you are, which rooms are already connected, and where exploration can continue.
steps.inventoryAndHelp: The lower-left area is your real inventory for items and omens. Open the reference card only when you need to check terms, not as a replacement for the main UI.
steps.finish: You now know to read the goal, action bar, speed, and room board first. The next chapter walks through a real use, move, and explore sequence.

moveExploreUse.title: Move, Explore, and Use
moveExploreUse.description: Walk through one real pre-haunt sequence of using an item, moving, and exploring.

steps.setupRuntime: The next steps jump into a real pre-haunt runtime state for the first scenario.
steps.useBook: Use the book first. The held item is already selected; the magnifier on the card only opens the large preview.
steps.useRope: Use the rope first. It grants extra movement so you can keep the room exploration going.
steps.moveToHallway: Now move to the Hallway. Green targets are real reachable rooms, not tutorial overlays.
steps.moveToGrandStaircase: Now move to the Grand Staircase. Green targets are real reachable rooms, not tutorial overlays.
steps.exploreUpper: Then use Explore to reveal the next room. Exploration really triggers an event, item, or omen.
steps.finish: You have now walked through a real use -> move -> explore sequence. That is the normal runtime rhythm.

crimsonJack.title: Crimson Jack Objective
crimsonJack.description: Explain what the heroes and the traitor are trying to do once the first haunt begins.

steps.setupHaunt: This chapter jumps directly into a real haunt state for the first scenario.
steps.hauntReveal: The first haunt is Crimson Jack Returns. Once the haunt starts, the revealer becomes the traitor.
steps.heroGoal: The hero line has three goals: learn about Jack, study two exorcism circles, then banish Jack's Spirit.
steps.traitorGoal: The traitor wants to kill the heroes, or return to life through Jack's Spirit. The board and actions stay on the same real page.
steps.finish: You should now understand that this haunt is driven by investigation, circles, and Jack's Spirit, not just combat.

hauntActions.title: Haunt Actions and Finish
hauntActions.description: Use a real endgame-ready haunt state to review help, haunt actions, and the true finish.

steps.setupReadyToExorcise: This chapter jumps to a real state where the heroes are ready to finish the exorcism.
steps.helpEntry: If you need to re-read the printed aid, open it here. The help entry stays lightweight and does not replace the action bar.
steps.hauntActions: The haunt-specific actions still live in the real bottom action row: learn, study, exorcise, and attack when needed.
steps.exorciseJack: Execute the real exorcise action now. A success leads straight into the actual endgame screen.
steps.endgameReview: This is the real hero-side finish for the first scenario, not a tutorial-only end screen.

traitorPath.title: Traitor View and Finish
traitorPath.description: Enter the first scenario from the traitor's turn and finish the real attack chain.

steps.setupTraitorTurn: This chapter jumps directly to Daryl's real traitor turn. The heroes are near defeat, so the traitor line can finish from the real board.
steps.traitorObjective: The traitor is not studying circles. The goal is to defeat every hero; if the traitor falls first, Jack's Spirit may take over and try to return.
steps.attackHero: Use the real room focus entry to attack a hero in the same room. This resolves through the normal opposed attack and damage rules, not a tutorial-only button.
steps.traitorFinish: This is the true traitor-side finish for the first scenario. The tutorial now covers both required first-scenario viewpoints.
